newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-ROOKIE REPLACES INJURED DOULL IN NZ SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ROOKIE REPLACES INJURED DOULL IN NZ SQUAD.

text.p: Rookie fast-medium bowler Shayne O'Connor was called into the New Zealand squad on Friday for the Independence Cup cricket tournament in India, replacing the injured Simon Doull.
Doull, New Zealand's senior strike bowler, was forced out of the tour by a stress fracture in his back.
O'Connor, 23, joins Heath Davis and Andrew Penn in the 14-strong squad as New Zealand's three-pronged fast-medium attack for the tournament, New Zealand Cricket said.
O'Connor, from the southern province of Otago, is a left-arm bowler who has the ability to swing the ball both ways.
New Zealand will play Pakistan next Friday, India on May 14 and world champions Sri Lanka on May 20 in the round robin tournament.
The top two teams will then play a best-of-three finals series.
